{{Quote|I won't involve myself with them again. For now I think they've forgotten me, and I want to keep it that way.|Drigor Tarrens' view of the Qektoth Confederation|<ref name="W" />}}
'''Drigor Tarrens''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] from a colony in the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]], a largely unexplored [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Believing that biological technology was superior to traditional inanimate technology, he joined a group of like-minded scientists known as the [[Qektoth Confederation]] who were based at the [[University of Sanbra]]'s [[Q'Maere Research Facility]] within the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. After a series of experiments came back with disappointing results, the scientists left the facility to pursue their own goals, and Tarrens accompanied them. During his time with the Confederation, the organization changed from a group of idealistic scientists trying to save [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from the perceived dangers of traditional technologies, to a militant order that advocated war against those that would use their technology to keep the population of the galaxy "enslaved." Tarrens disagreed with these views, and learned of a project that would use the genetic material of the Confederation's own members to create new life-forms.

Before Tarrens could reveal this plan to the rest of the organization, his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] exploded upon take-off, and his life was saved through the use of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. Charged with [[Treason/Legends|treason]], which was punishable by [[Death/Legends|death]], Tarrens fled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uukaablis]] and was granted [[Politics/Legends|political]] asylum. There, Tarrens lived in seclusion until the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' sought his help in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. They had encountered a [[Qektoth Confederation biochemical agent|biochemical agent]] created by the Confederation, and needed a cure for it. After learning that he might have been exposed to the agent as well, Tarrens directed them to a [[Qektoth Confederation Space Station|research facility]] in the [[Qu'mock system/Legends|Qu'mock system]]. After the ''FarStar'' delegation left, Tarrens discovered that he had indeed been infected by the agent, and realized that the crew of the New Republic [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was his only hope. Taking his personal [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] to the Qu'mock [[Star system/Legends|system]], Tarrens was instrumental in helping the ''FarStar'' to [[Battle of Qu'mock|defeat]] a [[Qektoth attack cruiser]] and recover the data needed to create a cure for the agent.

==Biography==
===Early life===
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Drigor Tarrens was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="W" /> in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]<ref name="Birthdate" /> on a colony along the edge of the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] filled with [[Nebula/Legends|volatile gases]] and [[lightstorm]]s, in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol Outback]].<ref name="W" /> In approximately [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Discovery">The events of ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'' take place four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which is stated to be in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] in ''[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|The Essential Chronology]]'', giving a date of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Drigor Tarrens is stated to be have found the [[Qektoth Confederation Space Station]] 26 years prior to the events of "[[Wildfire (adventure)|Wildfire]]," giving a discovery date of [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> he discovered an [[Qektoth Confederation Space Station|abandoned space station]] in an uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="W" /> and marked its location.<ref name="Note">Although the adventure "[[Wildfire (adventure)|Wildfire]]" implies that Tarrens found the station and brought it to the attention of the [[Qektoth Confederation]] immediately, this cannot be the case as Tarrens did not join the organization until roughly nine [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.</ref> Tarrens studied science, and eventually took up a post as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] at the [[University of Sanbra]]'s [[Q'Maere Research Facility]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Q'Maere]] within the Kathol Rift.<ref name="HW">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Harm's Way|book=The Kathol Rift}}</ref> Around [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]],<ref name="Qektoth Date">The events of ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'' take place four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which is stated to be in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] in ''[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|The Essential Chronology]]'', giving a date of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Drigor Tarrens is stated to have joined the [[Qektoth Confederation]] "over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] and a half ago", giving an approximate date of [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]].</ref> Tarrens joined a group of scientists known as the [[Qektoth Confederation]] who believed in the superiority of biological technology.<ref name="HW" /> They felt that the use of traditional, inanimate technology was sapping the spirits of ordinary people, and caused sickness and premature [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="W" /> After a series of experiments on [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]] biology failed to live up to their expectations, Tarrens and the Qektoth scientists left the facility to the staff from the University of [[Sanbra]].<ref name="HW" /> He revealed the location of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that he had discovered several years previously to his colleagues,<ref name="Note" /> and the Confederation moved the station to the [[Qu'mock system/Legends|Qu'mock system]]. They refitted and repaired it, and used it as a research station for their experiments.<ref name="W" />

===Qektoth Confederation===
[[File:QCspacestation.jpg|thumb|left|The space station discovered by Tarrens that the Qektoth Confederation would use for their own purposes.]]
Over the years, the Qektoth Confederation evolved from a group of idealistic scientists to a militaristic organization that wished to wage war against those that, in their view, kept [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in a weakened state through their reliance on inorganic technology. Many of the original founding members of the Confederation left the group, disgusted by what it had become, and the organization came under the leadership of [[Trann Shoame]]. Under Shoame, the Confederation extended their research into biological and chemical weapons, readying themselves for the day when they could strike at their perceived enemies.<ref name="W" /> Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Leaving Date">The events of ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'' take place four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which is stated to be in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] in ''[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|The Essential Chronology]]'', giving a date of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Drigor Tarrens is stated to have joined the [[Qektoth Confederation]] "over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] and a half ago" and then left the organization five years later, giving an approximate date of [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> the leaders of the Confederation began a project to create new life-forms with enhanced attributes. To achieve this, they took cell samples from all of the organization's members and planned to use them as part of their experiments. Tarrens learned of the project, and was disturbed by it. He decided to report his findings to the rest of the Confederation, but the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] he intended to travel in exploded just after he took off from a [[Qektoth Confederation base|secret base]] near the Kathol Rift.<ref name="W" />

Tarrens was recovered from the wreckage of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], and repaired with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] systems by Confederation [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] without his knowledge or approval. He was summoned to appear before a court on the charge of treason upon waking from surgery, which was punishable by death under the Confederation's laws. Tarrens managed to flee, heading for the planet [[Uukaablis]] and requesting [[Politics/Legends|political]] asylum. The native [[Uukaablian]]s, noted for their skills in creating and refining medical technologies, agreed to his request. Tarrens became a recluse on Uukaablis, living in cave in a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] away from the Uukaablian [[City/Legends|cities]]. At some point, he acquired a [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]].<ref name="W" />

===Arrival of the ''FarStar''===
{{Quote|Let's just say I still know some of the Confederation's codes.|Drigor Tarrens|<ref name="W" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="CurrentDate" /> Tarrens was approached by members of the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' for help. They had encountered a [[Qektoth Confederation biochemical agent|biochemical agent]] manufactured by the Qektoth Confederation that was rapidly spreading through the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] crew. They had originally sought the help of the Uukaablians and their advanced medical technology, but the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] had been unable to help the New Republic representatives, and had directed them to Tarrens. Tarrens initially refused to assist them, saying he wanted no dealings with the Confederation ever again. However, when the ''FarStar'' delegation informed him that the agent was contagious, and that he may have been exposed to it as well, he relented and gave them the coordinates for the Qektoth research facility located in the Qu'mock system, which was a only a [[Standard day/Legends|day's]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from Uukaablis. He told [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]], [[Commander/Legends|commanding]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the ''FarStar'', that she would find [[Computer/Legends|computer]] files on the station that they could use to develop an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] to the agent, and requested that she return to him with the antidote.<ref name="W" />

[[File:Helix-AJ5.png|thumb|right|A ''Helix''-class light interceptor]]
After the ''FarStar'' crewmembers left, Tarrens discovered that he had indeed been infected with the biochemical agent from his brief contact with the New Republic delegation. Realizing that his only chance for survival rested with the success of the ''FarStar''{{'s}} mission, he took his ''Helix'' light interceptor to the Qu'mock system to assist them. Arriving in the middle of a [[Battle of Qu'mock|battle]] between the ''FarStar'' and a [[Qektoth attack cruiser]] near the space station, he learned that the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] had a [[Mission group|raiding party]] aboard the Confederation facility attempting to recover the needed information. However, the small force was trapped on the station in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay&mdash;the Confederation had locked down the exits and set the station to [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]]. Tarrens used his knowledge of Confederation command codes to override the security locks remotely, opening the hangar doors and allowing the ''FarStar''{{'s}} raiding party to escape. Joining the battle between the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], he revealed that the attack cruiser had a weakness that they could exploit. Due to the energy requirements of the cruiser's [[Bio-energy array|unique weaponry]], the enemy vessel could only maintain its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] in a single fire arc at any time while employing them. Tarrens' suggestion was to use the ''FarStar'', the raiding party's [[Aegis-class Combat Shuttle|''Aegis''-class Combat Shuttle]], and his own interceptor to attack the vessel from multiple angles. His assistance resulted in victory for the ''FarStar''.<ref name="W" />

Back on Uukaablis, the Uukaablians were able to use the recovered data to create a cure for the biochemical agent, treating Tarrens and the ''FarStar'' crew. While waiting for the antidote to be created, Tarrens revealed his past to the New Republic delegation, and how he had wished to simply hide from the Confederation until he died. However, his experiences with the ''FarStar'' crew had changed his mind, and he hoped that he could atone for his past crimes.<ref name="W" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Come back for me.|Drigor Tarrens, to Captain Kaiya Adrimetrum|<ref name="W" />}}
Standing just under 1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, Drigor Tarrens wore his [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair in thick braids that hung down his back,<ref name="W" /> and by 8 ABY,<ref name="CurrentDate" /> it was starting to go gray. He was a scientist who held the belief that biological technology was superior to inanimate technology, a view that led him to join the Qektoth Confederation. However, Tarrens did not agree with the Confederation's militaristic outlook, or their plan to create new life-forms using genetic samples taken from its own members.<ref name="W" />

Living on Uukaablias, Tarrens learned the [[Uukaablian (language)|local language]], and had a working knowledge of other cultures and planetary systems. He was also familiar with the works of a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] and could swim. Tarrens also had a strong sense of self-preservation, fleeing from the Confederation when his life was threatened, and assisting the crew of the ''FarStar'' after realizing that their success was his only hope of surviving after being exposed to a deadly biochemical agent.<ref name="W" />

==Skills and abilities==
Despite believing in the superiority of biotechnology, Drigor Tarrens nevertheless used technological items such as starfighters, [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and his own cybernetic eye. He could operate [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] craft, fly space [[Transport/Legends|transports]], [[Astrogation/Legends|plot courses]] through both space and hyperspace, and use the weapons aboard capital ships. He had experience in [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming and repair, and could repair blasters as well. He was also experienced in [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee combat]], and the operation of vehicle-mounted blasters.<ref name="W" />

==Equipment==
Drigor Tarrens was trained to use a blaster, and possessed both a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster]] and a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out pistol]] for emergencies. His left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] had been replaced by a cybernetic substitute that stared straight ahead, no matter which way his other eye was looking at the time. In addition to his weapons, Tarrens generally wore a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="W" /> By 8 ABY,<ref name="CurrentDate" /> Tarrens owned and operated a ''Helix''-class light interceptor,<ref name="W" /> manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].<ref name="AJ5-AS">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Katholoutback.jpg|thumb|right|The cover of ''The Kathol Outback'']]
Drigor Tarrens was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure "[[Wildfire (adventure)|Wildfire]]," written by [[George R. Strayton]].<ref name="W" /> It was published as part of ''[[The Kathol Outback]]'' supplement for ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' by [[West End Games]]<ref name="KO">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref> on [[January 15]], [[1996]].<ref name="BN">{{BN|url=w/star-wars-the-roleplaying-game-west-end-games-incorporated/1018175964|text=Star Wars the Roleplaying Game: Darkstryder Campaign: Kathol Outback}}</ref> Tarrens would be mentioned again in the adventure "[[Harm's Way]]," which was published in [[The DarkStryder Campaign (series)|''The DarkStryder Campaign'']]{{'s}} subsequent supplement, ''[[The Kathol Rift]]''.<ref name="KR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref>
